device: 6.9" iPhone sizes (440 × 956 pt) at 3x, rendered in the iPhone Duo Simulator test host
notes: Renders, not runtime captures: the Simulator cannot draw widgets on a Home Screen, a Live Activity, or the Dynamic Island from the command line. WidgetRefreshRenderTests renders the real views fed by the Sample board through AppModel (SampleBoardSurfaces), with the data aged 13 min 36 sec (fresh) or 3 hours (stale). The Dynamic Island is Live rank's own region views on a drawn black island shape. The before renders ran the same test against origin/main (it was added there temporarily, not committed). Avatars are initials; nothing is fetched.
